Hi Carlos,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. Our procurement team requires suppliers to register in our Coupa tenant before we can issue POs. You mentioned hitting an "organization affiliation" error when creating the account — can you confirm which portal you were on (Coupa or Ariba) and paste the exact error text or attach a screenshot?

To speed manual provisioning if needed, please attach a copy of your W-9 (or equivalent tax document), the registered legal entity name, and the primary invoicing email. If you prefer, I can have procurement provision the account directly once we have those documents.

Next steps I recommend:
- Send screenshot of the error (helps procurement triage)
- Attach W-9 + company registration number
- Confirm the email(s) to receive invoices and PO copies

I'll loop in Marissa to coordinate payment/contract details and Vanessa to track the intake checklist.

Best,

On Tue, Nov 18, 2025 at 10:03 AM Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@zenmeds.com> wrote:
> We were on the Coupa link you sent last week... 
> Registration failed: organization affiliation mismatch...

Thanks Carlos — that error matches a common tenant-side duplicate check. Two likely causes: (1) an earlier registration exists for the same EIN under a different contact email, or (2) the marketplace record already lists your org under another buyer's supplier list which blocks self-enrollment.

I'll raise a manual provisioning request with procurement ops. Can you please attach the W-9 and a PDF with the company address? If you don't want to upload directly to Coupa, reply to this thread with the files and I'll drop them into the secure intake folder.

Marissa — FYI: if this is a Coupa duplicate, can procurement ops create the supplier record manually and map accounting@zenmeds.com as the invoice contact? We may need to set "allow invoice submissions" and confirm the legal name/EIN match.

Vanessa — please add the vendor to the onboarding checklist and schedule a follow-up for 11/20 to confirm account provisioning and PO issuance.

Thanks,
Nikhil
